Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and the PO. We can support a temporary uplift; want to outline two practical options so you can pick quickly:

Option A — Provisional top-up (fastest):
- Provision a temporary capacity reservation for the 48-hour window to target 400 QPS.
- Billing: blended uplift surcharge at $0.0045/token for excess tokens above your baseline, invoiced as a separate line item on the Sept invoice.
- No contractual amendment required; pay-as-you-go uplift with a commitment to the uplift window.

Option B — Short-term committed uplift (preferred for discount):
- Create a 1-month provisional commit that raises your committed capacity by X for September (we’ll calculate exact token buckets based on usage).
- Billing: reduced uplift price at $0.0035/token for excess within the provisional commit.
- Requires a short amendment (one-page) to the MSA and PO confirmation.

Notes: both options include a hard cap to prevent runaway spend — we can set a throttling guard at 520 QPS and notify you if consumption approaches that. If you expect predictable distribution of tokens (e.g., longer prompt lengths), send sample traffic numbers and we’ll refine the numbers.

If you want the discounted provisional commit (Option B), please confirm by EOD Friday 9/12 so Legal/Finance can get the amendment and invoice path ready. I’ve attached a draft quote for Option B.

Best,
Laura

- Window: 2026-09-20 00:00 PT to 2026-09-22 00:00 PT (48 hours).

1) Please confirm Option B by replying to this thread by EOD Monday 9/13 PT so Legal can send the amendment for signature and Ops can schedule the provisional pool.
2) Ben will ensure Finance has the invoice coding guidance; Connor will build the throttle guard and notify your SRE contact when provisioning completes.

If anything in the terms above needs tweaking we can adjust quickly, but we want to lock this by Monday to avoid late provisioning churn.
